expectedDiagnostic: surface heating present; low core equilibrium may be caused by the surface/carcass/core transfer and/or heat rejection balance rather than insufficient friction heat generation.

evidence: M131: current Dunlop Vintage/R5 guide gives 20 psi cold for an approximately 500 kg vehicle
M132: the same guide gives 24 psi hot
M001-M020 and M120-M130 use about 27 psi as a controlled dimensional/homologation measurement pressure, not a historical racing-pressure measurement

hypotheses.A: Current manufacturer application guidance supports approximately 24 psi hot for a 500 kg R5 application; direct 1960 BRM racing-pressure evidence remains absent.
hypotheses.B: Not presently supported: the generated approximately 20.2 psi cold start closely matches M131.
hypotheses.C: Leading pressure-only hypothesis: the generated 26 psi ideal is above both the 24 psi guide and the observed 22.2-23.5 psi equilibrium.
hypotheses.D: Still unresolved: observed pressure rise and low core equilibrium can also expose thermal/pressure coupling error.

pressureAudit.decision: hold all pressure and thermal coefficients; the completed 5x incident/abuse run does not resolve the pressure hypotheses
